name: Rob Sampson Memorial Most Valuable Wrestler Trophy

bestowals.source: The Dupree Cup MVW Announcement (9 December 2006).
bestowals.vote_detail: Co-Most Valuable Wrestlers for the inaugural Dupree Cup: HAL scored the clinching win in both the semifinal and final; Spoiler went unbeaten through every round. Both banked a future TEAM Championship of Champions shot.
Named by a panel of writers, wrestlers and administrators as the best wrestler of the 2007 Dupree Cup after carrying The A-List to the Cup as sole WarGames survivor.

bestowals.source: "Awards, title shots, props, general things Cup related" (9 December 2006).
bestowals.vote_detail: For carrying Team NFW to the playoffs almost single-handedly; earned a #1 contender's shot for the Championship of Champions and a guaranteed TEAM Challenge Championship shot on NFW programming.

name: The Frank Gore Award for the Chronically Underrated

bestowals.source: "Awards, title shots, props, general things Cup related" (9 December 2006).
bestowals.vote_detail: For an undefeated run through the Cup that went comparatively unnoticed; earned a #1 contender's shot for the Championship of Champions (against Jason Payne) and a guaranteed TEAM Challenge Championship shot on A1E programming.

name: The Jockstrap Award for Athletic Support

bestowals.source: "Awards, title shots, props, general things Cup related" (9 December 2006).
bestowals.vote_detail: For a standout performance in relief of Jason Payne during the playoff run; earned a spot in the four-way match to decide the TEAM Challenge Championship.

name: Best Supporting Wrestler on a Championship Team or Event

bestowals.source: "Awards, title shots, props, general things Cup related" (9 December 2006).
bestowals.vote_detail: For a hard-hitting run in support of New Era of Wrestling's championship win; earned a spot in the four-way match to decide the TEAM Challenge Championship.

name: The It's Too Early To Think of a Witty Name Award

bestowals.source: "Awards, title shots, props, general things Cup related" (9 December 2006).
bestowals.vote_detail: For being the second best player on the second best team; earned a spot in the four-way match to decide the TEAM Challenge Championship.
